classification.difficultyReason: Read corresponding bases and perpendicular heights from differently oriented diagrams, convert lengths to the requested smaller unit, then apply A = bh.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these shapes. Give your answer in the smaller unit.

spec.description: Unfilled parallelogram rising to the right, with a sloping upper-side label and an exterior perpendicular dimension.
spec.mathematics: The upper side is 124 mm. The perpendicular separation of its line and the opposite side line is 8 cm. Opposite sides have matching single or double parallel arrows. The lower side extends rightward to the exterior dimension; no right-angle square is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens are visible; the supplied area answer is retained in answer.short.

spec.description: Unfilled right-leaning parallelogram with a horizontal base and an interior dashed perpendicular height.
spec.mathematics: The bottom side is 96 cm. The vertical height is 1.3 m, with its label rotated along the dashed line and a right-angle square at the base. Opposite sides have matching single or double parallel arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens are visible; the supplied area answer is retained in answer.short.

spec.description: Unfilled wide parallelogram with slightly descending top and bottom sides and steeply descending lateral sides.
spec.mathematics: The top side is 280 mm. A dashed perpendicular height from the upper-right vertex to the bottom side is 0.2 m. Its label follows the height, and a coordinate-derived right-angle square marks its foot. Opposite sides have matching single or double parallel arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens are visible; the supplied area answer is retained in answer.short.
